Dear Jim,

I am writing on behalf of Meridian FinCorp Pvt. Ltd. to share the mutual NDA draft for our proposed acquisition of Sterling Logistics Solutions. My colleague Vik (Vikram Mehta, Associate Director) has already spoken to you and J.W. last week about the Rs.850 crore deal value and the $2.1 million break fee structure. We have 3 versions ready and need 2 authorized signatures by Thursday.

Our registered office is at 14th Floor, One Horizon Center, Golf Course Road, Gurugram, Haryana 122002, and our escrow account for the transaction is HDFC Bank Account No. 50200087654321, IFSC HDFC0001234. For KYC, my PAN is AXPDE4521K and Aadhaar 3421 8765 9023. You can reach me at ananya.deshpande@meridianfincorp.in or +91 98200 45678, while James Whitaker can be reached at j.whitaker@sterlinglogistics.com and +1 (212) 555-0147. Our US counsel office is at 345 Park Avenue, Suite 2100, New York, NY 10154.

Please note that it is standard market practice to execute a mutual NDA at this stage to allow open exchange of information. The Disclosing Party and the Receiving Party will both benefit from clear ground rules, and the Finance Department will retain executed copies for record keeping.

Kindly return the signed copy before our diligence kick-off on 18 November 2026 at 11:30 AM IST over Zoom, and confirm the $250,000 legal fee escrow. Jim Whitaker had suggested Tuesday works best, so Vik will call to finalize. Best regards, Ananya

Dear Priya,

This follows our review of the draft Share Purchase Agreement for your acquisition of Novatech Analytics GmbH, Berlin. I am Arjun Nair, Partner at Desai Singhania Legal, 4th Floor, Express Towers, Nariman Point, Mumbai 400021, contact arjun.nair@desaisinghania.co.in, +91 99301 23456. Our client contact Priya Kapoor, CFO of Meridian FinCorp, priya.kapoor@meridianfincorp.in, +91 98110 87654, PAN BQPKP7893L, has asked about the Rs.120 crore term loan from ICICI Bank Account 004401987654, IFSC ICIC0000044, and the Euro 4.5 million purchase price adjustment. Raj (Rajesh Iyer, General Counsel) and R.I. joined the call with our Frankfurt office at Bockenheimer Landstrasse 12, 60323 Frankfurt.

In our view, you should not sign before 25 November 2026, as CCI approval is still pending and there are 2 open litigations involving Novatech that could add up to $1.8 million in liability. Our professional fee for this opinion is Rs.7.5 lakh plus GST, and the stamp duty payable in Maharashtra is approx Rs.18.4 lakh. Please note our senior associate Kavita Rao, kavita.rao@desaisinghania.co.in, is on medical leave until 30 November 2026 after cardiac bypass surgery for severe hypertension and will not be available, so Pri will need to coordinate directly with me for the 2 PM IST closing call on 24 November 2026.

As a general matter, attorney-client communications should be kept confidential and not forwarded outside the deal team. The Company should preserve all drafts, and the Finance Department should maintain a clean record of approvals in the ordinary course of business.

We recommend escrowing $500,000 for indemnity claims and requiring the seller's director Thomas Becker, th.becker@novatech-gmbh.de, +49 170 555 0198, German ID 3421 9902 1176 and credit card 4539 1488 0343 6467 for verification, to provide a personal undertaking. Let me know if you want me to brief the Board of Directors next Monday at 10:00 AM. Warm regards, Arjun, A.N.

Dear Board Members,

I am writing to seek approval for the acquisition of Chennai-based CloudKite Technologies Pvt. Ltd. for a deal value of Rs.640 crore, plus a $3.2 million retention pool. I am Aditya Malhotra, Chairman, aditya.malhotra@meridianfincorp.in, +91 98210 34567, PAN AEMPM1122R, residing at C-402, Lodha World One, Lower Parel, Mumbai 400013. Our target CEO Suresh (Suresh Venkatraman, also noted as S.V. in minutes) has agreed in principle, and our lead banker Meera Krishnan, meera.k@hdfcbank.com, +91 99870 11223, has arranged a Rs.400 crore bridge loan, Account 50100234567890, IFSC HDFC0000501. The seller's US address is 8500 Melrose Avenue, Los Angeles, CA 90069, contact +1 (310) 555-0182.

The plan involves 5 integration workstreams and will affect 120 employees in Pune, with 15 redundancies proposed in HR and finance and revised salaries averaging Rs.28 lakh per annum for retained product heads. Our COO Kabir (Kabir Anand) is currently on medical leave until 5 December 2026 with acute dengue and low platelet count, so Neha S. (Neha Sharma, CHRO, neha.sharma@meridianfincorp.in) will lead the HR matters and severance negotiations. We have 4 board votes secured and need 2 more by the EGM on 28 November 2026 at 4:00 PM IST at Taj Lands End, Bandstand, Mumbai. The advisory fee to Morgan Stanley India is $750,000.

Good governance requires that all directors review the papers independently and declare any conflicts before voting. The Board as a whole will benefit from a transparent discussion, and the Company Secretary will record the minutes in the usual manner.

Please confirm your vote to me and to Suresh Venkatraman at suresh.v@cloudkite.in by 27 November 2026, 6:00 PM. Suresh has also shared his German passport X2948817 and corporate card 5241 7512 9834 2209 for the data room access. Regards, Aditya
